testcase.name: the address is checked before the name, so a missing one is never reported as unreadable
the device naming its own access point is enough
a device that will not name its access point is a dead end, not a wait
a named network with no password goes out open, and that is the caller's warning to give
a system configuration with an empty name is no configuration at all
an interface with no address of its own is not an access point yet
each field takes the user's override where there is one
the manual override is the way through on a device that hides its configuration
